notes: Proxy false-dead fix: accounts with a WORKING proxy were being marked 'proxy dead' and never opened. Liveness is now checked against several tiny neutral endpoints (not facebook.com, which blocks datacenter proxy IPs), a proxy counts as alive if it reaches ANY of them or even completes a tunnel/TLS handshake (a slow target/ReadTimeout is no longer 'dead'), and it's only declared dead when the proxy server itself is unreachable on every endpoint - re-confirmed twice. The in-browser check now treats a plain Facebook load timeout as 'retry then continue' instead of killing the account, while a hard proxy net-error still fails fast. Builds on v1.1.9.
